### Notice & Takedown Request Form

In accordance with GDPR (Articles 14, 17) and 152-ФЗ РФ, you may request the immediate redaction or deletion of your personal statements from the published dataset.

### Target Record Details
- **Dataset File:** [e.g. `sft_dialogues.parquet`, `full_clean_messages.parquet`]
- **Message ID / Thread ID:** [e.g. `msg_id: 12345` or `thread_id: 678`]
- **Approximate Date of Message:** [YYYY-MM-DD]

### Reason for Request
- [ ] Personal Name identified
- [ ] Contact details (phone / email) identified
- [ ] Private URL / Key identified
- [ ] Author Opt-Out from Research Corpus

### Action Requested
- [ ] Redact sensitive tokens with `[PERSON_REDACTED]`
- [ ] Completely remove record from dataset

---
*Note: All takedown requests are processed within 48 hours.*
